authority: Cambridge International AS & A Level Computer Science 9618 syllabus, 2027-2029, Version 2

records.resolution: Records the official lifecycle purpose, named stages and waterfall, iterative and RAD boundaries without substituting Agile for RAD.
Teaches the purpose and construction of structure charts, parameter arrows, and derivation into matching pseudocode headers and calls.
Teaches marked start states and directed event-labelled transitions, with construction practice and a clear separation from processing flowcharts.
Connects syntax, logic and run-time errors to ways of exposing, locating, correcting and avoiding faults, followed by regression testing.
Covers dry run, walkthrough, white-box, black-box, integration, alpha, beta, acceptance and stub testing in teaching, application and assessment.
Distinguishes and requires production of a project-wide test strategy and complete individual test-plan rows.
Retains the reviewed official normal, abnormal and extreme/boundary test-data categories and direct assessments.
Explains continuing maintenance and classifies corrective, adaptive and perfective changes from their reasons rather than the edited module.
Requires analysis of an existing program, coherent amendment to enhance functionality, new-path testing and regression of preserved behaviour.

Replaces unrelated evidence mappings and changeover-first questions with direct structure-chart derivation, testing-method, strategy/plan, error-correction and enhancement tasks while preserving assessment counts and marks.
Replaces a correction-only debugging visual with a deterministic analyse-amend-test enhancement model.
Replaces a nested-selection visual with distinct structure-chart, derived-pseudocode and state-transition panels.
Replaces a changeover-method visual with the required distinction between a test strategy and a complete test-plan row.
